map.平方律（Square Law）是人眼感知最线性的曲线，DMX512标准默认。S曲: Square law is the curve that looks most linear to the human eye and is the DMX512 default. The S-curve gives smoother transitions in shadows and highlights. A linear curve looks uneven to the eye at low brightness.
map.白炽灯/卤素灯调光宜用平方律（Square Law），使人眼感知亮度接近线性，避: Incandescent and halogen dimming should use the square law so perceived brightness is close to linear, avoiding "jumps" in the low end.
map.需要柔和的暗部与亮部过渡时选用 S 曲线，常用于渐变与呼吸效果编程。: Use the S-curve when smooth shadow and highlight transitions are needed, commonly for fades and breathing effects in programming.

map.算例：DMX 128 在平方律曲线下: Worked example: DMX 128 under the square-law curve
map.DMX 输入 128（约 50.2%）。平方律输出 = (128/255)² ×: DMX input 128 (about 50.2%). Square-law output = (128/255)² × 255 ≈ 64.3 / 255 (about 25.2%), a brightness gain of about 0.50×; at the same input, the linear curve outputs 128.0 (50.2%), the S-curve about 128.2 (50.3%) and the exponential curve about 45.5 (17.9%). Curve type strongly affects low-end brightness, and the square law is closest to human perception.
map.为什么 DMX 线性曲线看起来不均匀？: Why does a linear DMX curve look uneven?
map.人眼对亮度的感知接近幂律，线性映射会让低区偏暗、高区偏亮；平方律/对数曲线更贴近: Human brightness perception follows a power law, so a linear mapping makes the low end too dark and the high end too bright; square-law and logarithmic curves match vision better.
map.不同灯具必须统一曲线吗？: Must all fixtures use the same curve?
map.同场景混用曲线会导致渐变不一致；建议同批次灯具统一曲线类型并做灰度校准。: Mixing curves in the same scene makes fades inconsistent; use the same curve type for fixtures of the same batch and perform greyscale calibration.
